entries.hypothesis: campaign7 wordsum_selfkey (W1..W5 word-gematria-sum self-keying, sign x atbash) decodes the unsolved LP2 text; cells H4xF3, L2xF3.
entries.control_detail: planted-text analogue for EVERY one of the 20 variants x EN_MODERN/LATIN/EN_NOVOWEL (60 plants at level W, 60 at level P) enciphered with the exact inverse; exact recovery 1.000 asserted; 120/120 recognised (plant pmax > max of 3000 matched-null family bests; level W null max 4.62, level P 5.50). Archived-code copy reproduced campaign7's -6.897 and per-variant scores exactly.
entries.threshold: direct panel-R36 (round40 lib copied unchanged), standing matched null bars_matched.matched_shuffle blockperm 100/250/1000, D=1000 each; alpha 0.0025 per (family, level); decision p = max of the three block p's; crosses only if Z-family p AND raw p both <= alpha
entries.result: negative: level W (20 whole-stream variants) best pmax 2.705, decision p(Z)=0.538, p(raw)=0.374 (blocks 100/250/1000: Z 0.353/0.491/0.538, raw 0.368/0.374/0.366); level P (1,100 page units) best pmax 3.642, decision p(Z)=0.886, p(raw)=0.893. alpha 0.0025: no crossing.
entries.coverage: 20 variants (W1-W5 x sign x atbash) x 55 unsolved pages, panel-R36 direct, 12 registers, matched null at page/region scale with word and page segmentation held.
entries.not_covered: other prime tables, sum operators, word segmentations than the transcription's; skip-aware / doublet-aware variants; non-listed registers beyond plant-level EN_MODERN/LATIN/EN_NOVOWEL; key-sweep survivor bar not applicable (direct reading).
entries.reopens_if: a variant outside W1-W5 (different sum/segmentation) is defined, or a segmentation of LP2 other than the transcription's is shown to be the author's
entries.notes: Supersedes the inconclusive R14 reading in R40-C1-INCONCLUSIVE-R14 (premise 'code not committed' false; archive path used).
